remote_head_verification: Official GitHub READMEs read live; ls-remote timed out and commits/API fetches were unavailable. Fixed source snapshots, not a rolling latest claim.

architecture_assessment.ragged_and_selective_lmhead: Current myvllm implements packed/paged prefill and selected rows; the former feature gap is closed, not a speed-equivalence claim.
nano_remaining_strengths: Chained block hashes and memory-pressure preemption/recompute
Shard-aware direct checkpoint loader and automatic KV capacity
myvllm_scope: Decode-priority chunk scheduling and closed resource lifecycle
Complete Prefix blocks + boundary logits and exact-hit skip
Optional W4A16, HTTP/SSE and greedy prompt lookup
architecture_assessment.mini_version_caveat: Clean upstream/Windows graph captures hidden states. Dirty local main adds capture_logits for TP1, still samples outside graph; these states are not interchangeable.
architecture_assessment.mini_prefix_caveat: Inspected fixed version clears token IDs on release and prefills only new K/V with positions restarting at zero; not a verified persistent warm-prefix path.
myvllm_limitations: FP16 B2 strict elementwise KV threshold remains failed
CUDA prefill is correctness-first; dense backends still per-request attention

guard.note: Independent environments; no engine TPS, automatic speed ratio or isolation guarantee.

measurement.graph: 50-op graph by default; device events divided by op count
measurement.eager: Python callback launches plus final CUDA sync; wall divided by op count
measurement.excluded: CPU generation/hash/H2D, oracle, validation, import/JIT, capture, warmup, metadata

myvllm.scope: Same loaded runner and weights; generate_incremental(use_cuda_graph=False/True) changes only the per-call decode path. Runner latency spans prefill through last emitted token, excluding tokenization/text decode; outer call wall time includes those. First calls, warmup, nvidia-smi, file hashes and git queries are excluded from warmed summaries. No profiler or model hooks are active.

mini_vllm.measurement_caveat: Median of three latencies combined with last run's token count; per-run samples unavailable; generate includes input/output processing.

mini_fp16_rope.interpretation: Direct default-FP16 construction is not a validated Mini FP16 path. No model source was patched or full-model quality accepted.
